headline: US state department sits on twelve year backlog of alleged Israeli rights violations
label: NEWS
caption:
A new watchdog report reveals a massive delay in addressing human rights claims 🇮🇱

According to a report by the Office of the Inspector General, the US Department of State has a 12 year backlog of alleged cases of gross human rights violations in Israel.

The report highlights issues with applying the Leahy Law, which prohibits US military assistance to foreign security forces if there is credible information of human rights ab*ses.

Former state department officials said that opponents within the administration advanced legal arguments to avoid enforcing the law regarding Israel.
